text:
PHRF-09 remediation implementation completed locally on 2026-09-13 (uncommitted in the shared dirty checkout).

Changed only:
- modules/fit/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/fit/profile/ShapeDecoder.scala
- modules/fit/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/fit/profile/WorkReceipt.scala
- modules/fit/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/fmri/fit/profile/ShapeDecoderSuite.scala

Delivered contract:
- Data-only node scores remain available to ShapeEvidencePool; a distinct data-plus-prior bank now governs selection, ambiguity and fallback.
- Nonfinite scans and refused selected-node jets return DecodeStatus.NoAdmissibleNode with node=-1 where no node was finite and NaN coordinates/amplitudes/curvature, rather than indexing -1 or leaking worker state. A refused worker is tested across refusal followed by a valid voxel, and the production Gram backend is tested across NaN followed by finite sufficient statistics.
- Exact accepted points without a remaining terminal jet return BudgetExceeded and publish NaN Hessians/SD rather than the preceding point's curvature. Accepted continuous jets and fallback terminal verification bind amplitudes, data Hessian, augmented Hessian and SD to the returned coordinates.
- Newton-step, evaluation and candidate-attempt exhaustion are non-admitted. Candidate attempts and terminal verifications are explicit DecoderCounters and WorkReceipt fields. Existing public positional DecodeBudget and WorkReceipt argument order is preserved by appending the new optional fields.
- The original strict 1e-9 projected-step convergence default is retained. A caller may declare a looser chart-coordinate approximation tolerance explicitly; no cohort-tuned tolerance is baked in.
- Active-set projected Newton and bounded parabolic fallback remain; no optimizer or private generic solver was added. Reused d<=3 factor scratch removes new per-jet Cholesky allocations.

Verification on the final strict code:
- fitJVM ShapeDecoderSuite: 13/13 passed.
- fitJS ShapeDecoderSuite: 13/13 passed.
- scalafimCompileAll: passed warning-clean across JVM and Scala.js.
- firstLevelLawsJS profile slice: 19/24 passed; the five failures are the reopened condition admission/qualification assertions recorded on PHRF-21. TrialBanded 5/5, provider 2/2, certification 2/2, reduction laws and spike laws passed.
- Final focused JVM affected condition suites: 3/8 passed; the same five assertions failed. Separate earlier full firstLevelLawsJVM profile execution passed TrialBanded, provider, certification, reduction and spike surfaces.
- An earlier full fitJVM run passed 328/331; the three failures were unrelated dirty-tree structural/R-parity scenarios. All fit.profile suites in that run passed. A fitJS profile slice passed 27/27, and the final focused decoder rerun passed after all cleanup.

PHRF-09 closes for decoder correctness. Its dependent PHRF-21 remains open: old condition admission receipts relied on exact-moved points with stale curvature and therefore cannot be restored by these unit gates.
